messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Spike in gateway 502/504s observed on api-gw-edge-*. 3xx -> 5xx ratio jump at 1810004320, paging oncall.

mike_h: ack - oncall taking it. what region?

sara_dev: seeing it across eu-west and us-east. errors ~ 8% of requests, latency up 2x. frontend traces show gateway timeouts to internal-router.

paul_ops: I'm pulling gateway logs now. first look shows a flood of TCP resets from upstream router pool. Could be connection saturation.

mike_h: @paul_ops can you grab `netstat` and `nginx` error tail from a problematic node?

paul_ops: on it.

paul_ops: ran: `sudo ss -s` -> "TCP: total 123456 (estab 10230, timewait 98765)" on gw-03; lots of TIME_WAIT. nginx errors:
```
2026/03/14 14:12:02 [error] 2345#0: *1234 upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.1.2.3, server: , request: "POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://10.2.0.45:8080/", host: "api.redwood.ai"
```

ingrid_cs: customers reporting failed requests in dashboards. CS triage asking for ETA.

mike_h: initial hypothesis: upstream model-hosting pool overloaded, causing connections to drop, gateway returns 502/504. mitigation options: 1) throttle ingress to gw, 2) route to fallback group, 3) restart problematic upstream pool, 4) increase keepalive or reuse connections.

sara_dev: we just deployed a small routing tweak 12m ago to add EU sticky routing. Could be related. @deploy-bot can you confirm recent deploys?

deploy-bot: 1810003200: route-affinity-eu deployed to gateway config at 1810003250 by sara_dev. No rollbacks.

paul_ops: I can drop connections to a subset of upstreams and let autoscaler bring them back; or scale the upstream service pool now. Scaling is faster.

kai_prod: start scale-up of model-hosting in us-east and eu-west by +30% and enable extra burst nodes. Do it now?

mike_h: yes, scale. also flip on degraded-mode routing for public API: limit max inflight tokens per connection and reduce concurrency to keep latency SLOs.

paul_ops: running: `kubectl scale deploy model-hosting --replicas=13 -n prod` in eu-west and us-east. watching nodes.

paul_ops: scaling triggered; new pods initialising. showing reduced error rate on gw-04 in us-east (prelim). 5xx dropping from 8% -> 3% on that node.

sara_dev: I'm rolling back route-affinity-eu on a canary basis to test if config change is contributing. rollback command executed.

mike_h: good. also let's open a temporary heavier timeouts: set upstream read timeout from 60s -> 90s for gateway while pods boot.

paul_ops: changed nginx conf on cluster-gw to `proxy_read_timeout 90s; proxy_connect_timeout 10s; keepalive_timeout 75s;` reloading.

incidence-tl (mike_h): summary to CS: brief note: investigating increased 502/504s, scaling upstream, rolling back recent routing change, temporary timeout adjustments. ETA 15-30m.

ingrid_cs: thanks — sending that to customers now.

paul_ops: after scale + rollback + timeout bump, global 5xx is down to ~1.1% and trending down. latency back to baseline in ~2m for most requests.

mike_h: continuing to monitor for 30m. opening a follow-up ticket to root cause: connection churn -> investigate TCP TIME_WAIT pattern and upstream connection handling (keepalive, pool sizes).

kai_prod: recommendation for post-mortem: add circuit-breaker on gateway to fail fast to known healthy backend set, and add autoscale headroom for burst scenarios.

sara_dev: adding changes to canary plan: revert sticky-eu flag into feature-flagged rollout, add integration test around connection reuse.

paul_ops: creating incident doc in GH: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/incidents/1810004321 (draft).

mike_h: handing off to @sara_dev for follow-up and postmortem. I'm going offline for a support call. thanks team. :thumbsup:

sara_dev: taking it — will update timeline and RCA later today.

deploy-bot: deploy-notes: route-affinity-eu rollback completed at 1810004550.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: Declared: mitigated -> monitoring. Mode: Post-incident review scheduled.

mike_h: resolved for now. if errors climb again, page pager.

ingrid_cs: customers informed; several requested downstream logs — will coordinate with SRE.

sara_dev: last note: we'll keep the timeout bump for 2 hours, then revert once autoscaler stable. closing thread when PM doc posted.
